clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once broke down something most diets never mention: your body holds three kinds of fat, and only one of them refuses to move no matter how hard you work out.

Crash diets burn the fat you actually need first - the kind cushioning your joints. Lose enough of it and a sore heel or aching knee can show up before the mirror changes.

The deep layer your body guards like an emergency reserve is the one every yo-yo dieter keeps fighting.

Next time the scale won't budge, ask which fat you're really losing.
